component.name: Jotter
component.summary: Local-first Markdown notes that sync through WebDAV or your own PC

description.p: Jotter keeps all your notes in a local database and lets you choose where they sync: a folder such as a USB stick, a WebDAV server, or this PC as a hub for your phone over Tailscale. It needs no account and works without a network.
The AppImage also holds the jotter command, for notes from a terminal or a script.
